QuestInfo.name: Hungry Ronnie
QuestInfo.1: I found #p608#'s son, #b#p320##k, inside a tree tunnel near #m10002000#. He declared that he'd never hand over the red book, but he was also pretty hungry. Ronnie asked me to defeat #r#o35#s#k in the western area of #m10002000# and bring back #b30 #t4000031#s#k.
QuestInfo.2: I brought a bunch of #t4000031#s for the hungry #p320#. But it looked like he still wanted to eat more...

0.0: Ah... You want this red book, huh?? I see... My daddy likes this book more than he likes me! This book... NO, I can't give you this book!! (stomach growling...) Ahhh!
0.1: No... no... I'm NOT hungry...! Dang... a-all right. I'll give you back the book. BUT! Not for free! I'm starving, and I need some food, so... if you get me something to eat, the book is yours. I promise!
0.2: I want to eat #b30 #t4000031#s#k. How can I eat that many, you ask? Don't worry about that.
0.3: If you ever get hungry on the way back and eat some of them... my dad's book is going to the #o31#s! So you better take care of that food!!!

1.0: Wow! That's #b30 #t4000031#s#k, just like I asked for! Let's see... Maybe I'll try one right now!

item.0: You haven't gotten the #b30 #t4000031#s#k yet? Bring them to me, and I'll give my dad's book back to you. I promise!

mob.0: Don't forget to teach those #o35#s a lesson too!
